questions.prompt:
Roy, Molly, Frank and Maude are all keen gardeners. As the diagrams show, they each have room for 10 plants in their plots so they can grow either flowers, trees or vegetables.

Ray grows more flowers than Maude, and Molly has more trees in her garden than Frank. Together Maude and Molly have more vegetables than the men.

Which garden belongs to each gardener?

questions.prompt: Using the digits 0-5 inclusive, write one number in each small circle so that the values around each large circle add up to ten.
questions.correctAnswer: Place 5 at the top-left outer intersection, 2 at the left inner intersection, 1 at the upper inner intersection, 0 at the lower inner intersection, 3 at the right outer intersection and 4 at the lower-left outer intersection.
